purpose: Offline integrity and coverage audit of instrumentation research artifacts; no acquired code executed and no physical device I/O.
method: Python standard-library SHA-256 over archived raw/text/image bytes; LF-only retained-byte line intervals; exact full-coverage and page-set equality; relative document link existence.
claim_limit: Structural audit verifies artifact integrity and recorded coverage consistency, not that reading occurred, comprehension, native conformance, device behavior or hardware safety.
